blinding_guess.why: With intra-process enabled, the publisher validates the requested QoS (publisher.hpp:166-177) while the subscription validates the middleware-resolved actual QoS (subscription.hpp:157-169); SystemDefaultsQoS maps system-default history to KeepLast depth 0 (qos.cpp:69) and system-default durability, so Node::create_publisher with SystemDefaultsQoS and use_intra_process_comms(true) appears to throw where the matching create_subscription would not.
